Chapter 657 - 657 Mecha; Discovered!

Chapter 657 - 657 Mecha; Discovered!

657 Mecha; Discovered!

Professor Huang’s voice was like a stone thrown into a calm lake, setting off waves.

“Really?” Chu Zhi asked. “Has it been proven?”

“At least, I didn’t find any major problems,” Professor Huang said. “Of course, the specific steps and details still need to be checked.”

“Oh right, who is it? Who wrote the proof of Method A?”

“He’s a student from our class, Lin Fan,” said Chu Zhi.

After saying that, he looked up at Lin Fan.

In fact…

Not only was Chu Zhi looking at Lin Fan, but everyone in the class was also looking at him.

Professor Huang looked over. When he saw Lin Fan’s young and handsome appearance, he said, “Good, good, good!”

Three ‘good’s in a row were enough to express the excitement in his heart.

Firstly, it was because Lin Fan was a student at Jiangbei University.

Secondly, Lin Fan was young!

This meant that Jiangbei University had produced a very promising math genius!

Professor Huang said, “Student Lin Fan, are you interested in becoming my graduate student?”

As soon as he said this, everyone present had a look of envy on their faces.

Among them… This included their teacher, Chu Zhi.

This was because Professor Huang from Jiangbei University was the most important person in the entire mathematics world!

All these years, he had never taught any students.

Now, he wanted Lin Fan to be his graduate student.

If Lin Fan wanted to develop in the mathematics world in the future, then it could be said that he would reach the heavens in a single step.

However, Lin Fan said calmly, “I’m sorry. I think it’s good enough for me to be in Class 2011.”

Professor Huang’s student?

What a joke!

Professor Huang might be quite famous in the mathematics world.

However, so what?

He could not even prove the simple Method A.

Besides, Professor Huang was a mathematics professor at Jiangbei University. In a sense, he could be considered Lin Fan’s own student.

What was more, the reason why Lin Fan came to Jiangbei University was entirely because he wanted to be classmates with Xia Xue.

The students and Chu Zhi were all stunned.

They did not expect Lin Fan to reject them.

This was Professor Huang!

Professor Huang, on the other hand, did not have much of a reaction.

He nodded slightly. “It’s indeed a little unfair to be my student. In the future, we’ll be like friends. We’ll discuss and communicate. What do you think?”

Lin Fan said, “If I’m not busy, sure.””

After all, Professor Huang was his student.

It did not matter if he helped him when he was free.

However, these words gave everyone a different feeling.

Lin Fan was a little too… proud.

Professor Huang did not take it to heart. He smiled and said, “Then it’s a deal!”

Then, he made a copy of the proof process of Method A and prepared to go back and check it carefully.

The math class was a small interlude.

Next was the mecha class.

In today’s world, technology was advanced, and there were people with special abilities…

However, it was not as peaceful as it seemed.

There were powerful beasts that ran out of the forbidden area, terrifying special ability users, technological criminals, and at the same time, there was war!

This made everyone need to have a certain degree of self-protection ability.

Hence, mecha classes came into being.

At this moment, everyone in Class 2011 had arrived at the incomparably empty field.

The teacher with the buzz cut and a strong body named Hawkins said, “Today is the mecha shooting class! Everyone, get into your mechas!”

Following that, a red mechas about three meters tall appeared in front of everyone.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but reveal an expression of interest.

It was cool and tall.

Any mecha, if it was a thousand years ago, would definitely be the Gundam that was loved by many people!

Now, real mechas were all neatly arranged in front of him.

At this moment, the hatch in front of the mechas opened, and the students stepped forward.

Lin Fan followed suit and walked in.

The temperature inside the mecha was moderate and very comfortable.

A halo appeared above his head.

This was a mental connection device similar to a gaming helmet.

This would allow the mechas to move freely like their own limbs.

At this moment, a row of targets appeared in the middle of the field.

“No. 1, shoot!”

“Bang!”

A hole immediately appeared on the third circle of the target.

“No. 2, shoot!”

“No. 3, shoot!”

…

As Hawkins shouted, holes appeared on the targets.

Soon, it was Lin Fan’s turn.

“No. 12, shoot!”

The super smart watch on Lin Fan’s wrist made a crisp sound. “Master, do you need me to lock onto the bullseye?”

Lin Fan said, “No need, I’ll shoot.”

Then, he slightly focused his attention.

The shot hit the bullseye!

Hawkins could not help but look at Lin Fan a few more times and nodded his head.

“No. 13, shoot!”

…

A day of classes passed in the blink of an eye.

In the past, Lin Fan only felt that the teachers’ lectures were like a lullaby that could make him fall asleep easily.

The curriculum of the current world gave Lin Fan a fresh feeling.

The setting sun dyed the distant sky scarlet.

It was ferocious and terrifying!

Lin Fan walked alone on the long path, maintaining a constant speed.

A gentle breeze blew past, causing the branches to sway gently. The leaves kept falling.

The next moment, Lin Fan turned around and looked at a forest not too far away.

In the forest, a man who was hiding in a silver mecha and observing Lin Fan quietly. He was slightly shocked.

He had been spotted?

Attack!

Then, the man no longer hesitated. With a slight thought, he fired the bullet.

“Hmm? What happened?”

The bullet did not fire as smoothly as he had expected.

Just as the man was feeling puzzled, Lin Fan, who was originally a few hundred meters away, suddenly appeared in front of him.

Lin Fan sized up the mecha.

He looked like he was looking at a large toy.

Lin Fan nodded, “It looks good.”

“I wanted to take it apart during class. I wanted to buy one, but now I can save that bit of money.”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan stretched out his hand and grabbed at the entrance.

The steel door suddenly shattered like a bubble.

Under the man’s shocked gaze, Lin Fan pulled him out and threw him on the ground.

Then, Lin Fan ignored the man.

Instead, he began to disassemble the mecha.

Not long after, the tall and cool mecha was reduced to a pile of broken parts.

At this moment, Lin Fan remembered that the man who wanted to kill him was still beside him.

“Who sent you here?” he asked.

His voice was very calm.

However, it made the man feel the temperature drop. He could not help but shiver.
